title: GxP Compliance in Life Sciences Is Non-Negotiable: SAP Is Raising the Standard
summary: A GxP-ready public cloud ERP solution from SAP supports life sciences and regulated industries customers as modern, cloud-based enterprises.
body_markdown:
At SAP, our mission has always been to help the world run better and improve people’s lives. Nowhere is that mission more tangible or more consequential than in life sciences.


Run resilient operations while accelerating innovation and improving outcomes


[Learn how](https://www.sap.com/industries/life-sciences.html)


Pharmaceutical manufacturers, biotech companies, and medical device makers operate in environments where precision is not a preference; it is a regulatory mandate. Product quality and patient safety depend on it.


That commitment has never been static. As life sciences evolve, so does our investment in the capabilities that enable our customers to operate with confidence.


Today, one of the most significant expressions of that commitment is SAP’s dedication to delivering a good practice (GxP)-ready public cloud ERP solution. This solution will help ensure that our life sciences and regulated industries customers can bring their most regulated processes into a modern, cloud-based enterprise with the controls, auditability, and validation rigor their industries demand.


## **Why GxP compliance is more critical than ever**


Supporting GxP across enterprise systems is more critical than ever. GxP is the collective term for all regulatory standards that govern how life sciences companies design, validate, document, and operate systems and processes that can affect product quality or patient safety.


As organizations adopt cloud technologies, AI, and advanced manufacturing while operating in increasingly complex global supply chains, the volume of regulated data has grown significantly. Data integrity has become the foundation of GxP compliance, with regulators increasingly expecting organizations to demonstrate that regulated data remains accurate, complete, consistent, attributable, and traceable throughout its life cycle.


The scope of GxP compliance has also expanded far beyond the manufacturing floor. Regulated data now moves across cloud platforms, AI tools, business systems, and connected enterprise applications. Compliance must extend across the entire technology landscape, ensuring data integrity, properly governed processes, end-to-end traceability, and confidence in every regulated decision.


## **SAP’s commitment: Extending GxP readiness to the public cloud**


GxP readiness in SAP’s public cloud ERP is not a feature layered onto a standard product; it is built into every layer of the solution. That means four dimensions of GxP readiness working together:


1. **GxP-ready SAP S/4HANA application:** Core ERP functionality that customers can validate, providing the documentation, traceability, and audit controls regulated businesses require
2. **GxP-ready cloud operations:** Managed services and change management processes aligned with GxP expectations for operational integrity and control
3. **GxP-ready implementation tools:** Accelerators and methodology support for reduced validation effort during deployment and upgrades
4. **GxP-ready data centers:** A certified infrastructure that meets the physical and logical security requirements of regulated industries


SAP is advancing GxP compliance across its integrated portfolio, spanning SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP Business Technology Platform, and SAP Business AI, including Joule. Life sciences customers will not need to maintain separate validation frameworks for different parts of their SAP landscape.


## **What this means for life sciences companies**


“As a growing mid-sized CDMO, TriRx requires a GxP-ready ERP platform to support its complex manufacturing and supply chain operations,” said Scott Harris, SVP and CIO of TriRx Pharmaceutical Services. “SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition provides end-to-end GxP support while enabling the agility of a public cloud environment, helping us move faster and maximize the value of our technology investments.”


As one leading global life sciences company noted: “To fully embrace the SAP technology stack with embedded AI utilizing data stored in SAP Business Data Cloud, functional capabilities in SAP Business Technology Platform, and write-back to the ERP system, the entire technology stack should be GxP compliant.”


## **From GxP-ready cloud to AI-ready industry**


When the foundation of an enterprise system is validated, auditable, and trusted by regulators, it becomes the launchpad for a new generation of AI agents purpose-built for regulated industries, agents that can only deliver on their promise when the systems they operate within meet GxP standards.


Public cloud-based GxP systems can employ a growing suite of AI agents to dramatically accelerate GxP-related work, from data validation to change management to impact assessment. These agents are already in production at several global pharmaceutical companies, reshaping how software validation and quality teams operate.


GxP compliance is not a feature. It is a promise to patients, regulators, and the organisations that depend on life sciences companies to operate with the highest standards of quality, integrity, and trust.


SAP has been GxP-ready in private cloud for years, and now we are bringing that same standard to public cloud so our customers can move forward with confidence.
